title: Near-misses in Gambling

lines.text: Did you know near-misses in gambling can actually make you want to keep playing?
Researchers used a simplified slot machine task to study this.
Near-misses, though not winning, still boost your desire to play.
This effect is stronger when you have control over the outcome.
Brain scans show near-misses activate the same reward areas as wins.
These findings help explain why near-misses feel so compelling in gambling.
Understanding this can help us better grasp gambling behaviors.

sources: Clark L, Lawrence AJ, Astley-Jones F, Gray N (2009). Gambling near-misses enhance motivation to gamble and recruit win-related brain circuitry. Neuron 61(3):481-490. PMID 19217383
